item.title: (4,7) buckets
item.description:
One of these days a friend mentioned this internet puzzle, which can be stated as follows: You have two buckets. One bucket with capacity of 4 L, and another with 7 L. Using only these two buckets, you are asked to obtain exactly 6 L of water. The problem also establishes two rules, namely:

  1. You have infinite water, and can waste it as much as you want.
  2. You can move water from one bucket to another, but only in a way that at least one of the two buckets ends up either empty or full.
